description: mark or unmark a habit done for today from the list
spec:
1. Wire the today toggle to the check-in mark/unmark hooks.
2. Marking today increments the current streak immediately.
3. Unmarking today decrements/resets the current streak.
4. Prevent duplicate same-day marks (button reflects done state).
5. Confirm the weekly grid updates in sync with the toggle.
title: Today done toggle
